before: 新建一集：分配新集 ID，插在 ``after`` 之后（缺省放在末尾）；带原文时是自带原文的集。
after: Create an episode: allocate a new episode ID and insert after ``after`` (default: append); supplied source text makes it an own-source episode.

before:
删除一集（硬删除）。

先不带 ``revision`` 调用，得到 ``status=confirmation_required`` 与服务端成文的丢失清单 ``impact.text``；
创作者确认后带上 ``impact.revision`` 重新提交。清单在两次调用之间变了时再次返回确认，不删除。
after:
Delete an episode permanently.

First call without ``revision`` for ``status=confirmation_required`` and the server-written loss list ``impact.text``.
After creator confirmation, resubmit with ``impact.revision``. If the list changed between calls, request confirmation again without deleting.

before: 调整播出顺序：把这一集移到 ``after`` 之后。切出集之间保持源文顺序。
after: Reorder broadcasting: move this episode after ``after``. Preserve source order among extracted episodes.
Summaries of existing drafts for this episode.

before: 丢弃草稿，回到正式内容。
after: Discard the draft and return to formal content.

before: 一份草稿的呈现视图：违约与降级提示逐条目定位；Agent 的可编辑草稿不带正文。
after: A draft presentation view with violations and degradation hints located per item; editable Agent drafts omit the body.

before: 手修保存：服务端全量重判，违约清零即采用为正式内容，否则返回刷新后的草稿视图。
after: Save manual repairs: the server fully revalidates, adopting as formal content when violations clear; otherwise return the refreshed draft view.

before: 提交 AI 修复，返回生成批次：只改违约所在的条目，修完照常重判，违约清零即采用。
after: Submit AI repair and return a generation batch: modify only items with violations, revalidate normally, and adopt once violations clear.

before: 把一个未引用文件移进项目回收站；其余角色在服务端一律拒绝。
after: Move an unreferenced file to the project trash; the server rejects all other file roles.

before: 列出 ``path`` 目录（缺省为项目根）的直接子项。
after: List direct children of ``path``, defaulting to the project root.
